text: Right. I've got the front. You mind the doors.
Thank you. Now they'll have to come through me.
Here, have yours back. I'll take this one.
Fair swap. Look after the old girl.
That's the stuff. Back in business.
I'm dry! I need ammunition up here!
Over here! In the cockpit! My legs are caught under the panel. I can't get out, but I can still shoot.
Hello? Is someone in the cabin? Hand me a rifle and I'll keep the nose clear.
Selwyn. Flight Lieutenant. I'm stuck fast in here. Give me something that shoots.
